notablePrerequisites: Moritte of the Frost and Ioreth of the Healing House do not have summoning sickness.You control at least one additional legendary creature.
description:
Activate Ioreth's second ability by tapping it, untapping Moritte and any other legendary creature you control.
Activate Moritte by tapping it, untapping Ioreth.
Repeat.
